task: Upgrade Repro-First into a hard lifecycle gate for PLAN and DEV entry so code-changing stories cannot proceed without an accepted repro/red-review binding.
outcome: When a code-changing story lacks accepted repro evidence, the terminal prints a blocking message such as Cannot enter PLAN or Cannot enter DEV, includes missing_story_evidence_binding, and points the user to story_create_from_repro; when a valid binding exists, the same lifecycle advance succeeds normally.
facts: The user requested this gate to be implemented through the B-1731 story flow rather than as an ad hoc patch.
The evidence platform already provides repro-probe, repro-review, and story-evidence-binding candidate artifacts.
B-1731 covers the repro-first story-intake preflight gate scope.
The selected approach shares binding validation across IDEA-to-PLAN and DEV entry, while global story_create enforcement remains bounded by explicit preflight and bypass semantics.
constraints: Use the B-1731 Lattice story flow.
Only code-verifiable stories should be hard-blocked; non-code stories and stories without file declarations must not be accidentally blocked.
The gate must mechanically validate artifact digest, storyId, probe, and review consistency.
Historical story artifacts must pass the English artifact gate before REVIEW-to-TEST.
